name: Bộ chuyển đổi USB 3.0 sang Ethernet Gigabit TP-Link UE300 V4
summary: Bộ chuyển đổi USB 3.0 sang Ethernet Gigabit
Equipped with a USB 3.0 port and Gigabit Ethernet port, UE300 provides a high-speed data transfer rate up to 1000Mbps.
Its foldable and portable design ideally suits any Ultrabook.
specs: USB 3.0 to Gigabit Ethernet Network Adapter, Quick Installation Guide
